questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ See you in Saturday!
questions.explain: 错。星期几永远 on：on Saturday。Part 5 最爱考这个。

questions.q: The film starts ___ seven o'clock.
questions.explain: 时刻是点 → at seven。

questions.q: We go swimming ___ summer.
questions.explain: 季节是大盒子 → in summer。

questions.q: I was born ___ 2015.
questions.explain: 年份是大盒子 → in 2015。

questions.q: There is a picture ___ the wall.
questions.explain: 墙是竖着的面，贴在上面 → on。

questions.q: We go to school ___ bus.
questions.explain: by + 交通工具，整块背：by bus。

questions.q: My grandma lives ___ Shanghai.
questions.explain: 城市 → in Shanghai。

questions.q: Let's meet ___ the school gate.
questions.explain: 校门口是约定的点 → at。

questions.q: I do my homework ___ the evening.
questions.explain: 傍晚是盒子 → in the evening。

questions.q: The stars come out ___ night.
questions.explain: 深夜习惯用 at night，整块背。

questions.q: We walked ___ the park to the library.
questions.explain: from A to B：从公园到图书馆。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ The frog jumped into the water.
questions.explain: 对。跳「进」水里 → into（进盒子）。

questions.q: My piano lesson is ___ four o'clock ___ Friday.
questions.explain: 时刻 at four + 星期几 on Friday。

questions.q: We visited my aunt ___ the Spring Festival.
questions.explain: 节日期间习惯用 at：at the Spring Festival / at Christmas。

questions.q: The cat is hiding ___ the sofa.
questions.explain: 藏在沙发「下面」→ under。

questions.q: The library is ___ the cinema and the bank.
questions.explain: 在两者「之间」→ between A and B。

questions.q: My school is ___ to the park.
questions.explain: next to = 紧挨着，整块搭配。near 后面不加 to。

questions.q: The dog is sleeping ___ the tree.
questions.explain: 在树「下」→ under the tree。

questions.q: I usually get up ___ 6:30 ___ the morning.
questions.explain: 时刻 at 6:30；早上这个时间段 in the morning。

questions.q: She has been ill ___ Monday.（听懂即可）
questions.explain: since + 起点 = 从周一到现在。KET 读到能懂即可。

questions.q: Look! Your photo is ___ the newspaper!
questions.explain: 报纸内容算「在里面」→ in the newspaper。但「在电视上」是 on TV，整块背。

questions.q: Dad goes to work ___ foot.
questions.explain: 步行是 on foot，唯一不用 by 的交通方式。

questions.q: The plane flew ___ the mountains.
questions.explain: 从上方飞「越过」→ over。on 是贴着，over 是悬空在上。

questions.q: Please listen ___ the teacher carefully.
questions.explain: listen to 整块搭配。

questions.q: We are waiting ___ the bus.
questions.explain: wait for 整块搭配：等某人/某物。

questions.q: Look ___ the blackboard, please.
questions.explain: look at 整块搭配：看向一个点。

questions.q: My cousin comes ___ Canada. She speaks English and French.
questions.explain: come from = 来自。

questions.q: There is a bridge ___ the river.
alt: across
questions.explain: 桥横跨河「上方」→ over/across the river。

questions.wrong: See you in Saturday morning!
questions.explain: 4 号中式错误（黄区）：具体某天的早上跟着那天走 → on Saturday morning。

questions.wrong: The train leaves on 8 o'clock.
questions.explain: 时刻是点 → at 8 o'clock。

questions.wrong: We went to there by taxi.
questions.explain: there 自带方向，不加 to。同理：go home / come here。

questions.wrong: I listened music before bed.
questions.answer: I listened to music before bed.
questions.explain: listen to 的 to 不能丢——中文「听音乐」没有小词，最容易漏。

questions.wrong: She goes to school by her bike.
questions.answer: She goes to school by bike.
questions.explain: by + 交通工具中间什么都不加。要强调她的车可说 on her bike。

questions.wrong: My birthday is in the 5th of July.
questions.answer: My birthday is on the 5th of July.
questions.explain: 具体日期是「那一天的面」→ on。月份才用 in（in July）。

questions.wrong: I'll visit my grandparents in next week.
questions.answer: I'll visit my grandparents next week.
questions.explain: next / last / this / every + 时间词，前面不加介词。

questions.wrong: The bird flew out the window into the garden.
questions.answer: The bird flew out of the window into the garden.
questions.explain: 出盒子是 out of，两个词都要：out of the window。

questions.q: 辨析：「书在桌上」vs「苹果在树上」——The apples are ___ the tree.
questions.explain: 苹果长在树上，贴着树 → on the tree。（外来挂上去的鸟也是 in the tree？——鸟藏在枝叶「里」用 in，长在树上的果实用 on。）

questions.q: 辨析：arrive ___ Beijing / arrive ___ the station
questions.explain: 大地方是盒子 → arrive in Beijing；小地方是点 → arrive at the station。

questions.q: 辨析：哪句是对的？
options: I watched a great film on TV at night.
I watched a great film in TV at night.
I watched a great film on TV in night.
I watched a great film at TV on night.
questions.explain: on TV + at night，两个都是整块搭配。

questions.q: 哪句是错的？
questions.explain: late for school 才对。good at / afraid of / interested in / late for——形容词的搭配也整块背。

questions.from: 中译英：我们周日早上十点在电影院门口见。（用 meet, cinema）
questions.answer: Let's meet at ten o'clock on Sunday morning at the cinema.
alt: We will meet at ten on Sunday morning at the cinema.
Let's meet at ten on Sunday morning at the cinema.
Let's meet at the cinema at ten o'clock on Sunday morning.
Let's meet at the cinema at ten on Sunday morning.
We meet at ten o'clock on Sunday morning at the cinema.
questions.explain: 三个介词各就各位：at ten（点）、on Sunday morning（那天的早上）、at the cinema（约定的点）。

questions.q: 一句里三个空：My aunt lives ___ a small town ___ the south ___ China.
questions.explain: in a town（盒子）+ in the south（方位在内部）+ of China（属于）。

questions.q: 「墙上有个洞」怎么说？
options: There is a hole in the wall.
There is a hole on the wall.
There is a hole at the wall.
There is a hole by the wall.
questions.explain: 洞是「陷进墙里」的 → in the wall；画是「贴在墙面」的 → on the wall。看东西是嵌进去还是贴上去。

questions.wrong: We arrived to the airport at six.
questions.answer: We arrived at the airport at six.
questions.explain: arrive 不搭 to：小地方 arrive at，大地方 arrive in。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：My swimming lesson is ___ Tuesday afternoon.
questions.explain: 具体某天的下午 → on Tuesday afternoon。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：School starts ___ half past eight.
questions.explain: 时刻 → at half past eight。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：We are going to Hainan ___ the winter holiday.
alt: during
questions.explain: 假期是一段时间的盒子 → in/during the winter holiday。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：You can put your coat ___ my bed.
questions.explain: 放在床「上」贴着面 → on。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：I got a letter ___ my pen friend in London.
questions.explain: 来自朋友 → from。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：Let's go ___ the museum ___ bike.（第二空）
questions.explain: to the museum + by bike。by + 交通工具。

questions.q: KET 写作邀请信：「周六下午三点在公园门口见」哪句全对？
options: Let's meet at 3 p.m. on Saturday at the park gate.
Let's meet on 3 p.m. in Saturday at the park gate.
Let's meet at 3 p.m. in Saturday on the park gate.
Let's meet in 3 p.m. on Saturday in the park gate.
questions.explain: at 时刻 / on 星期 / at 地点（约定的点）。写邀请信必用句式。

questions.q: KET 口语描述图片：一只猫在椅子下面睡觉。哪句对？
options: A cat is sleeping under the chair.
A cat is sleeping in the chair.
A cat is sleeping down the chair.
A cat is sleeping at the chair.
questions.explain: 在……下面 → under。

questions.q: 读懂指路（KET 阅读常见）：The bank is ___ the supermarket, so they share a wall.
questions.explain: 共用一面墙说明紧挨着 → next to。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：Thank you ___ your birthday present!
questions.explain: thank you for… 整块搭配。写感谢信第一句就用。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：I'm really good ___ swimming, but bad at running.
questions.explain: good at / bad at，后半句已给提示。

questions.wrong: 写作自查：I waited you at the bus stop for an hour!
questions.answer: I waited for you at the bus stop for an hour!
questions.explain: wait for 的 for 不能丢。

questions.wrong: 写作自查：My father works in a hospital on the centre of the city.
questions.answer: My father works in a hospital in the centre of the city.
questions.explain: in the centre of… 中心在城市「内部」→ in。

questions.q: 综合：Peter goes ___ school ___ foot, but ___ rainy days he takes the bus.
questions.explain: go to school + on foot + on rainy days（具体的那些天 → on）。

questions.q: 综合辨析：哪句有介词错误？
options: We arrived in London at night.
The cinema is between the two shops.
I'll see you in next Monday.
questions.explain: next Monday 前不加介词。其余全对。

questions.q: 综合：The mouse ran ___ of the box and hid under the bed.
questions.explain: 出盒子 → out of。

specialWords.groupName: at = 点：钟点和小地点
specialWords.rule: at 是「一个点」——时间上的一刻、地图上的一个小点。说几点钟、说门口/家里这种小位置，用 at。

specialWords.groupName: on = 面：具体某一天和表面
specialWords.rule: on 是「贴在面上」——日历上具体的一天（星期几、几月几号）是一个「格子面」，用 on。

words.zh: 在 5 月 1 日（具体日期）

specialWords.groupName: in = 盒子：时间段和大空间
specialWords.rule: in 是「装进盒子里」——月份、季节、年份是大段时间，早上/下午/晚上也是时间段；城市、国家是大空间。

specialWords.groupName: 交通方式：by + 光杆交通工具
specialWords.rule: by + 交通工具时，工具是「光杆」的——不加 a/the/my。唯一例外：走路说 on foot。

words.zh: 坐公交 ★不说 by a bus
步行 ★唯一用 on 的

lessons.title: 代词 + 限定词：a 是新朋友，the 是老朋友

sections.h: a 的前世是 one，the 的前世是 that
sections.text: a 从 one 磨损而来——「某一个、第一次提到」；the 从 that 磨损而来——「就是那个、你知道的那个」。所以：第一次出现用 a（新朋友），再次提到用 the（老朋友）：I saw a dog. The dog was hungry.
考纲限定词只有两个用法：a + 可数单数；the + 可数/不可数。不用背复杂规则。
做主奏用 I / he / she / we / they；站在动词后面挨「打击」用 me / him / her / us / them：He helped me.（不是 He helped I）。
口语常听到，但书面要写 Tom and I（做主语时）。Part 5 黄区考点。

examples.en: I bought a book. The book is about space.
examples.zh: 我买了一本书。这本书讲太空。
examples.note: 新朋友 a → 老朋友 the

examples.en: Tom and I are in the same class.
Miss Lee teaches us music.
Can you pass me the salt?

lessons.accept: 验收：Part 5 格式的冠词/代词填空 4/6 以上。
lessons.parentScript: 家长话术：读英文小故事时让她圈 a 和 the，每圈一个说「新朋友还是老朋友？」。玩三次就有感觉。

exercises.q: There is ___ orange on the plate. (a/an/the)
exercises.explain: 第一次提到 + 元音开头 → an。

exercises.q: I have a cat. ___ cat is black and white. (a/the)
exercises.explain: 第二次提到，老朋友 → the。

exercises.q: My grandpa often tells ___ funny stories.
exercises.explain: 动词后面 → 宾格 us。

exercises.q: ___ and I went fishing yesterday.
exercises.explain: 主语位置：Tom and I（不是 Me and Tom）。

exercises.q: Is this ___ pen or mine? (your/you)
exercises.explain: 名词前用物主代词 your。

exercises.q: 改错：I have book.
exercises.explain: 可数单数第一次提到要 a——黄区错误，Part 5 直接考。

exercises.q: I saw a bird. ___ bird was drinking water. (a/the)
exercises.explain: 第二次出现 → 老朋友 the。

exercises.q: Do you want ___ apple? (a/an)
exercises.explain: 元音开头 → an。

exercises.q: This is not my pen. It's ___.
exercises.explain: 句尾单独用 → hers（她的东西）。

exercises.q: Our teacher gave ___ a lot of homework.
exercises.explain: 动词后 → 宾格 us。

exercises.q: ___ bag is this? — It's Tom's.
exercises.explain: 问「谁的」→ Whose。

exercises.q: Look at ___! He can dance!
exercises.explain: 介词 at 后 → 宾格 him。

exercises.q: 改错：Me and Lily are in the same class.
exercises.answer: Lily and I are in the same class.
exercises.explain: 黄区错误5：主语位置用 I，且先说别人。

exercises.q: 改错：She is an university student.
exercises.explain: university 读音以 /j/ 开头（you），用 a 不用 an——看读音不看字母。

exercises.q: 改错：I have dog. Dog is very cute.
exercises.answer: I have a dog. The dog is very cute.
exercises.explain: 第一次 a（新朋友），第二次 the（老朋友）。

exercises.q: 验收（Part 5 形状）：填一词——Where is ___ nearest bus stop?
exercises.explain: 最高级前面 → the。

teaching.essence: a 是新朋友（第一次提到的某一个），the 是老朋友（你我都知道的那个）；代词有两副面孔——做主奏用 I/he/she，站在动词后面用 me/him/her。
teaching.why: a 从 one 磨损而来，the 从 that 磨损而来。所以 a book 骨子里是「（随便）一本书」，the book 骨子里是「那本书（你知道的）」。中文靠上下文就能分清，不用小词，所以中国孩子要么全漏（I have book）要么乱加。记住讲故事的节奏就够了：第一次出场 a（新朋友进门），再次提到 the（老朋友回来）。代词的两副面孔中文也没有——「我」永远是「我」，英文却分「我做事」（I）和「事落到我身上」（me）。

rules.point: a 新朋友 → the 老朋友
rules.detail: 第一次提到用 a（某一个）；再次提到、或你我都知道是哪个，用 the。KET 只考两条：a + 可数单数；the + 可数/不可数都行。

examples.en: I saw a dog in the park. The dog was very hungry.
examples.zh: 我在公园看见一只狗。那只狗很饿。（新朋友→老朋友）

examples.en: Can you close the door?
examples.zh: 把门关上好吗？（你知道是哪扇门）

rules.point: a 还是 an：听声音
rules.detail: 后面的词以元音「音」开头用 an：an apple / an egg / an hour（h 不发音）；注意看的是声音不是字母：a university（读 /ju/，辅音音）。

examples.en: She eats an egg and a banana every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上吃一个鸡蛋和一根香蕉。

examples.en: It took us an hour to get there.
examples.zh: 我们花了一小时到那里。（hour 的 h 不发音）

rules.point: 代词的两副面孔
rules.detail: 做主奏（动词前）用 I / he / she / we / they；站在动词或介词后面用 me / him / her / us / them。判断法：看它在动词的前面还是后面。

examples.en: He helped me with my homework.
examples.zh: 他帮我做作业。（动词后 → me）

examples.en: Miss Lee teaches us music.
examples.zh: 李老师教我们音乐。（动词后 → us）

examples.en: Come with us!
examples.zh: 跟我们一起来！（介词后 → us）

rules.point: 「谁的」：形容词性 vs 名词性
rules.detail: my/your/his/her/our/their 后面必须跟名词（my violin）；mine/yours/his/hers/ours/theirs 单独站（The violin is mine）。

examples.en: This is my seat, and that one is yours.
examples.zh: 这是我的座位，那个是你的。

examples.en: Her bag is red. Mine is blue.
examples.zh: 她的包是红色的，我的是蓝色的。

rules.point: Tom and I：书面的规矩
rules.detail: 口语里常听到 Me and Tom…，但书面做主语要写 Tom and I（把别人放前面，自己用 I）。做宾语时才是 Tom and me。

examples.en: Tom and I are in the same class.
The teacher praised Tom and me.
examples.zh: 老师表扬了汤姆和我。（动词后）

notes: 快速自测「a 还是 the」：能在心里补出「随便哪个都行」→ a；能补出「就是那个」→ the。
不用冠词的情况：人名地名（Beijing）、语言学科（English, maths）、三餐（have breakfast）、by + 交通工具（by bus）、复数泛指（I like dogs 不是 the dogs）。
it 和 they 也有宾格：it 不变（still it），they → them：I like them.
「it 的」是 its，没有撇号——it's 是 it is 的缩写，两个长得像但完全不同。

commonErrors.wrong: I have book.
commonErrors.why: 中文说「我有书」，没有冠词这种东西，所以最容易整个漏掉。可数单数名词前面必须有 a/an/the/my 之类的「帽子」。8 类错误 6 号（黄区）。

commonErrors.wrong: Me and Tom are good friends.
commonErrors.right: Tom and I are good friends.
commonErrors.why: 口语顺口但书面算错：做主语用 I，而且礼貌上把别人放前面。8 类错误 5 号（黄区）。

commonErrors.wrong: The teacher praised I.
commonErrors.why: 中文「我」不分格，英文动词后面要换成 me。判断法：它在动词后面 → 用宾格。

commonErrors.wrong: This is a apple.
commonErrors.why: apple 以元音音开头 → an。连读起来才顺口——an apple 本来就是为了好念才存在的。

commonErrors.wrong: I like the music very much.（泛指喜欢音乐）
commonErrors.why: 泛指「音乐这种东西」不加 the；加了 the 变成「那段音乐」。中文两种说法都是「我喜欢音乐」，所以容易多加。

teaching.parentTip: 读英文小故事时让她圈 a 和 the，每圈一个问一声「新朋友还是老朋友？」。玩三次就有感觉，不用讲规则。

questions.q: 第一次提到一只狗：I saw ___ dog in the park.
questions.explain: 新朋友第一次出场 → a。

questions.q: 接着再说它：___ dog was very hungry.
questions.explain: 老朋友回来了 → The dog。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ I have book.
questions.explain: 错。可数单数前要戴帽子：I have a book.

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ This is an apple.
questions.explain: 对。apple 元音音开头 → an。

questions.q: She ate ___ egg for breakfast.
questions.explain: egg 元音音开头 → an egg。

questions.q: He is ___ good student.
questions.explain: good 辅音音开头 → a。

questions.q: 「他帮了我」：He helped ___.
questions.explain: 动词后面 → me。He helped I 是典型错。

questions.q: 「我们喜欢她」：We like ___.
questions.explain: 动词后面 → her。

questions.q: 「跟我们来」：Come with ___.
questions.explain: 介词 with 后面 → us。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ Tom and I are in the same class.
questions.explain: 对。做主语用 I，别人放前面。

questions.q: 书面写作里这句对吗？→ Me and Tom are good friends.
questions.explain: 错（书面）。做主语 → Tom and I。

questions.q: 「这是我的琴」：This is ___ violin.
questions.explain: 后面有名词 violin → my。mine 要单独站。

questions.q: 「这把琴是我的」：This violin is ___.
questions.explain: 后面没有名词 → mine 单独站。

questions.q: I like ___ (they). They are funny.
questions.explain: like 后面 → them。

questions.q: Can you pass ___ the salt?
questions.explain: pass 后面 → me：把盐递给我。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ Please close the door.
questions.explain: 对。你我都知道是哪扇门 → the。

questions.q: My uncle is ___ engineer.
questions.explain: engineer 元音音开头 → an。说职业要带冠词：He is an engineer.

questions.q: I go to school ___ bus.
questions.explain: by + 交通工具不戴帽子：by bus。

questions.q: We had ___ lunch at school today.
questions.explain: 三餐前不加冠词：have lunch / have breakfast。

questions.q: ___ sun rises in the east.
questions.explain: 独一无二的东西 → the sun / the moon / the sky。

questions.q: She plays ___ piano every day.
questions.explain: 弹奏乐器习惯加 the：play the piano / the violin。（运动不加：play football）

questions.q: My cousin lives in ___ Beijing.
questions.explain: 城市名前不加冠词。

questions.q: This is Lily. ___ is my best friend.
questions.explain: 做主语 → She。

questions.q: Where is my pen? I can't find ___.
questions.explain: 一支笔 → it；动词后 it 不变形。

questions.q: These are my parents. I love ___ very much.
questions.explain: 动词后 → them。

questions.q: Is this ___ schoolbag? — No, it's his.
questions.explain: 后面有名词 schoolbag → your。答句 his 单独站，没错。

questions.q: The dog wagged ___ tail happily.
questions.explain: 「它的」是 its，没有撇号。it's = it is。

questions.q: Our classroom is big, but ___ is bigger.
questions.explain: 单独站表示「他们的（教室）」→ theirs。

questions.q: I waited ___ (he) at the gate for ten minutes.
questions.explain: 介词/动词后 → him：waited for him。

questions.q: Look at that bird! ___ (it) wings are blue.
questions.explain: 「它的」翅膀 → its，不带撇号。

questions.q: My aunt gave ___ (we) some mooncakes.
questions.explain: gave 后面 → us。

questions.q: There is ___ old piano in the music room.（a/an/the）
questions.explain: old 元音音开头 → an old piano。第一次提到。

questions.wrong: I have book about space.
questions.answer: I have a book about space.
questions.explain: 6 号中式错误（黄区）：可数单数要戴帽子 → a book。

questions.wrong: Me and Anna went shopping yesterday.
questions.answer: Anna and I went shopping yesterday.
questions.explain: 5 号中式错误（黄区）：做主语用 I，别人放前面。

questions.wrong: The teacher asked I a question.
questions.answer: The teacher asked me a question.
questions.explain: 动词后换面孔：asked me。

questions.wrong: This is a interesting film.
questions.explain: interesting 元音音开头 → an。

questions.wrong: I bought a book and a pen. A book was expensive.
questions.answer: I bought a book and a pen. The book was expensive.
questions.explain: 第二次提到那本书 → 老朋友 the。

questions.wrong: Her is my little sister.
questions.explain: 做主语 → She。her 只能站在动词后或名词前。

questions.wrong: This is you seat. My is over there.
questions.answer: This is your seat. Mine is over there.
questions.explain: 名词前用 your；单独站用 mine。两处都要改。

questions.wrong: We visited the Beijing last summer.
questions.explain: 城市名前不加 the。

questions.q: 辨析：I like ___ music.（泛指喜欢音乐）
questions.explain: 泛指「音乐这种东西」不加 the。加 the 就变成特指某段音乐。

questions.q: 辨析：___ film we saw last night was great.
questions.explain: 「我们昨晚看的那部」已经锁定是哪部 → The。

questions.q: 哪句是错的？
options: She goes to school on foot.
He is reading an interesting story.
Their house is next to ours.
questions.explain: to 后面要宾格：to her。

questions.q: 哪句全对？
options: My brother and I made a cake for our mother.
Me and my brother made a cake for our mother.
My brother and me made a cake for we mother.
I and my brother made a cake for ours mother.
questions.explain: 主语 My brother and I + 名词前 our。

questions.from: Tom helped Lucy.（用代词替换两个名字）
questions.explain: Tom 做主语 → He；Lucy 在动词后 → her。

questions.from: This is my violin.（用 mine 改写）
questions.explain: my + 名词 = 名词 + is mine。

questions.q: It's 和 its：___ raining, and the dog is shaking ___ wet fur.
questions.explain: It's = It is（正在下雨）；its = 它的（毛）。

questions.q: 一段话综合：I met ___ old man at the bus stop. ___ man smiled at ___.
questions.explain: an old man（元音音+第一次）→ The man（老朋友）→ smiled at me（介词后）。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：I got ___ new bike for my birthday. It's red.
questions.explain: 第一次提到 + new 辅音音开头 → a。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：We watched a film last night. ___ film was about a lost cat.
questions.explain: 第二次提到 → The film。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：My father is ___ artist. He paints animals.
questions.explain: 职业 + artist 元音音开头 → an artist。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：Lucy is my best friend. I sit next to ___ in class.
questions.explain: 介词 to 后面 → her。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：My grandparents have a farm. I visit ___ every summer.
questions.explain: 爷爷奶奶两个人，动词后 → them。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：Is this ___ first visit to London?（你的）
questions.explain: 名词 visit 前 → your。

questions.q: KET 写作：想写「我和妹妹给妈妈做了张卡片」，哪句能拿分？
options: My sister and I made a card for our mum.
Me and my sister made a card for our mum.
My sister and me made a card for us mum.
I and my sister made a card for we mum.
questions.explain: 主语 My sister and I；「我们的妈妈」→ our mum。

questions.q: KET 口语 Part 1：Who do you live with? 最自然的回答：
options: I live with my parents. They are very kind to me.
I live with my parents. Them are very kind to I.
I live with me parents. They are very kind.
I live with my parents. They is very kind to me.
questions.explain: 主语 They + 动词后 me + 名词前 my，三副面孔各就各位。

questions.q: 读朋友的消息：My cat is lost! I can't find ___ anywhere. 填什么？
questions.explain: 一只猫 → it（不知公母时用 it 最safe——此处答案 it）。

questions.q: KET 阅读理解：Sam borrowed Ben's bike because his was broken. 句里的 his 指谁的车？
questions.explain: Sam 借 Ben 的车，正是因为 Sam 自己的车坏了——his 单独站，回文里找主人。阅读题常这样考代词。

questions.wrong: 写作自查：I love my school. A school has a big library.
questions.answer: I love my school. The school has a big library.
questions.explain: 第二句说的还是「我的学校」→ 老朋友 The school（或 It）。

questions.wrong: 写作自查：My friend and me often play chess after class.
questions.answer: My friend and I often play chess after class.
questions.explain: 做主语 → My friend and I。

questions.from: The teacher gave the students some homework.（把 the students 换成代词）
questions.answer: The teacher gave them some homework.
questions.explain: gave 后面 → them。

questions.q: 综合：Whose eraser is this? — It's not ___ (I). Ask Tom.
questions.explain: 单独站表示「我的（橡皮）」→ mine。

questions.q: 综合：___ moon looks very big tonight.
questions.explain: 独一无二 → the moon。

questions.q: 综合辨析：哪句有错？
options: She plays the violin in an orchestra.
I saw the elephant at a zoo yesterday, and a elephant was huge.
questions.explain: D 两处错：第一次提到应是 an elephant，第二次应是 the elephant——顺序全反了。

specialWords.groupName: 宾格：动词/介词后面换这套
specialWords.rule: 代词站在动词或介词后面（被动作「打到」的位置）要换宾格衣服。you 和 it 偷懒不换装。

specialWords.groupName: 形容词性物主代词：后面必须跟名词
specialWords.rule: 「谁的+东西」——这套词是形容词，后面必须挂一个名词：my book, their school。

specialWords.groupName: 名词性物主代词：单独站着不带名词
specialWords.rule: 「这是我的」——这套词自己就能站住，后面不跟名词：This book is mine.（his 两套同形）

specialWords.groupName: 反身代词：自己对自己
specialWords.rule: 「自己」= self（单数）/ selves（复数）。★注意：是 himself / themselves，不存在 hisself / theirselves！

specialWords.groupName: a / an：看音不看字母！
specialWords.rule: 用 a 还是 an，听第一个「音」而不是看第一个字母：hour 的 h 不发音，开头是元音音 → an hour；university 读 /juː/，开头是辅音音 /j/ → a university。

words.zh: 一个诚实的男孩 ★h不发音

lessons.title: 连接词：连奏线

sections.text: KET 考纲连接词只有 7 个：and, but, or / when, where, because, if。像连奏线把两个音连成一句，让句子不再一个个蹦。
and 加一句、but 转折、or 二选一：I like apples and bananas. I can sing but I can't dance.
when 什么时候、where 什么地方、because 为什么、if 如果：I was happy because we won.
连接词不光 Part 5 考，还直接抬高写作的 Organisation 维度分——25 词的小作文里放一个 because 和一个 then，就从「蹦豆子」变成「有线条」。

examples.en: I practised hard, and I passed the test.
examples.zh: 我努力练习，然后通过了考试。

examples.en: I like music because it makes me happy.
examples.zh: 我喜欢音乐，因为它让我开心。

examples.en: Call me when you get home.
If it rains, we will stay at home.
examples.zh: 如果下雨我们就待在家。

lessons.accept: 验收：用 because / but / when 各口头造一句，25 词小作文里自然用上 2 个连接词。
lessons.parentScript: 家长话术：她说任何一句英文后，你问一声 Why?，引导她加 because…。这是最便宜的写作提分动作。

exercises.q: I wanted to go out, ___ it was raining.
exercises.explain: 想出门 ↔ 下雨，转折 → but。

exercises.q: Do you want tea ___ juice?
exercises.explain: 二选一 → or。

exercises.q: I was late ___ I missed the bus.
exercises.explain: 说原因 → because。

exercises.q: ___ you are free tomorrow, let's play chess.
exercises.explain: 如果 → if。

exercises.q: I lived in a town ___ there was a big lake. (when/where)
exercises.explain: 挂地方 → where。

exercises.q: 用 because 把两句连成一句：I like winter. I can skate.
exercises.answer: I like winter because I can skate.
exercises.explain: 连奏线 because 连接结果和原因。

exercises.q: Hurry up, ___ we will miss the train!
exercises.explain: 「否则」→ or。

exercises.q: I was tired, ___ I finished my homework.
exercises.explain: 累 ↔ 仍完成，转折 → but。

exercises.q: We can't play outside ___ it is raining.
exercises.explain: 给原因 → because。

exercises.q: I was doing homework ___ you called me.
exercises.explain: 「…的时候」→ when。

exercises.q: This is the shop ___ I bought my violin strings. (when/where)
exercises.explain: 挂地方 → where。

exercises.q: ___ you finish early, we can play chess. (If/But)
exercises.explain: 条件 → If。

exercises.q: 用 but 连成一句：I can swim. I can't dive.
exercises.answer: I can swim but I can't dive.
exercises.explain: 转折用 but。

exercises.q: 用 when 连成一句：I was five. I started school.
exercises.answer: When I was five, I started school.
exercises.explain: when 挂时间。

exercises.q: 改错：I like music. Because it makes me happy.（两句合一）
exercises.answer: I like music because it makes me happy.
exercises.explain: because 把原因挂在主句后面，不单独成句。

exercises.q: 验收：用 because 口头说一句你喜欢的东西和理由
exercises.answer: I like winter because I can skate.
exercises.explain: 意思通顺即可——写作口语都靠这个句型。

teaching.essence: 连接词是连奏线——把两个音连成一句，让句子不再一个个蹦。KET 只考 7 个：and / but / or + when / where / because / if。
teaching.why: 中文很爱「蹦句子」：「我喜欢音乐。它让我开心。」两个短句并排放，中间连「因为」都可以省。英文短句太多会被当成「不会组织」——KET 写作专门有一个 Organisation 维度看你会不会连线。好消息：只要 7 个词。25 词的小作文里放一个 because 和一个 and，就从「蹦豆子」变成「有线条」，这是最便宜的提分动作。

rules.point: 并排连三兄弟：and / but / or
rules.detail: and 加一句（而且）、but 转折（但是）、or 二选一（或者/否则）。连接的两边分量相等，像两个音符并排。

examples.en: I like apples and bananas.
I can sing but I can't dance.
Do you want tea or juice?

rules.point: 挂一句四兄弟：when / where / because / if
rules.detail: 把一个短句「挂」到主句上：when 挂时间、where 挂地点、because 挂原因、if 挂条件。挂的那半句不能单独存在。

examples.en: Call me when you get home.
I like music because it makes me happy.
examples.zh: 我喜欢音乐，因为它让我开心。（口语写作万能句型）

examples.en: If it rains, we will stay at home.
examples.zh: 如果下雨，我们就待在家。

rules.point: because 和 so 只能上一个
rules.detail: 中文习惯「因为……所以……」成对出现，英文一句话里只能请一个：Because it rained, we stayed home. 或 It rained, so we stayed home. 两个都上就是双指挥。

examples.en: It was cold, so I wore a coat.
Because it was cold, I wore a coat.
examples.zh: 因为天冷，我穿了外套。（两句意思一样，各用一个词）

rules.point: if 句的小机关
rules.detail: if 挂的半句用一般现在，主句用 will：If it rains, we will stay at home.（不是 If it will rain）。条件还没发生，但 if 半句里不放 will。

examples.en: If you practise every day, you will pass the exam.
examples.zh: 如果你每天练习，就会通过考试。

notes: 写作顺序词也算连线：First… Then… After that… Finally…——看图写故事按这个骨架写，Organisation 分稳了。
because 后面挂的是「原因句」，答 Why 的提问必用它：Why do you like…? — Because…
when 挂过去的事：When I was five, I started playing the violin.——这是自我介绍的高分句。
and 连三个以上：A, B and C（最后一个前放 and）：I bought apples, eggs and milk.

commonErrors.wrong: Because it rained, so we stayed at home.
commonErrors.right: It rained, so we stayed at home.
commonErrors.why: 中文「因为……所以……」成对，英文只能请一个。because 和 so 同台 = 双指挥，必删一个。

commonErrors.wrong: I like dogs. Because they are cute.
commonErrors.right: I like dogs because they are cute.
commonErrors.why: because 挂的半句不能单独成句（句号一隔它就孤零零了）。口语答 Why 时单说 Because… 可以，写作里要连在主句上。

commonErrors.wrong: If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.
commonErrors.right: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
commonErrors.why: if 半句里不放 will——条件用现在式表达，主句才用 will。

commonErrors.wrong: I was tired. I went to bed early.（两句蹦豆子）
commonErrors.right: I was tired, so I went to bed early.
commonErrors.why: 不算语法错，但 KET 写作 Organisation 维度会压分——句子之间没有线。加一个 so/and/because 就是分。

commonErrors.wrong: I like both apples and also bananas.
commonErrors.why: 中文「既……也……」翻译过度，堆了 both/also 一堆词。and 一个词就够。

teaching.parentTip: 她说任何一句英文后，你问一声 Why?，引导她加 because…。这是最便宜的写作提分动作，一天两次就够。

questions.q: I like apples ___ bananas.（而且）
questions.explain: 加一句 → and。

questions.q: I can sing ___ I can't dance.（但是）
questions.explain: 前后转折 → but。

questions.q: Do you want tea ___ juice?（还是）
questions.explain: 二选一 → or。

questions.q: I like music ___ it makes me happy.（因为）
questions.explain: 挂原因 → because。

questions.q: ___ it rains, we will stay at home.（如果）
questions.explain: 挂条件 → If。

questions.q: Call me ___ you get home.（……的时候）
questions.explain: 挂时间 → when。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ It was cold, so I wore a coat.
questions.explain: 对。so = 所以，一句里只有它一个指挥。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ Because it rained, so we stayed at home.
questions.explain: 错。because 和 so 是双指挥，只能留一个。

questions.q: Hurry up, ___ you will be late!（否则）
questions.explain: or 还能表「否则」：快点，否则要迟到。

questions.q: She is only five, ___ she can play the piano.（却）
questions.explain: 年纪小「却」会弹琴 → but。

questions.q: I was hungry, ___ I ate two eggs.（所以）
questions.explain: 结果 → so。

questions.q: Why do you like summer? — ___ I can swim!
questions.hint: 提示：答 Why 必用它
questions.explain: 答 Why → Because。口语这样单用可以。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ I bought apples, eggs and milk.
questions.explain: 对。三个并列，最后一个前放 and。

questions.q: ___ I was five, I started playing the violin.
questions.explain: 「五岁的时候」是时间 → When。自我介绍高分句。

questions.q: This is the school ___ my mother works.（地点）
questions.explain: 挂地点 → where。

questions.q: 「因为……所以……」翻成英文时，because 和 so 都要写出来。这个说法对吗？
questions.explain: 错。英文一句只请一个：要么 because，要么 so。

questions.q: I wanted to buy the book, ___ I didn't have enough money.
questions.explain: 想买「但」钱不够 → but。

questions.q: Put on your coat, ___ you will catch a cold.
questions.explain: 穿上外套，「否则」感冒 → or。

questions.q: We stayed at home ___ it was raining hard.
questions.explain: 空格后是原因 → because。

questions.q: It was raining hard, ___ we stayed at home.
questions.explain: 空格后是结果 → so。和上一题正好互为镜像。

questions.q: ___ you mix blue and yellow, you get green.
questions.explain: 条件 → If。

questions.q: I'll show you the photos ___ I see you.
questions.explain: 见到你「的时候」→ when。

questions.q: Which do you like better, spring ___ autumn?
questions.explain: 二选一的提问 → or。

questions.q: My brother likes sports, ___ I like reading.
questions.explain: 两人爱好相反 → but。

questions.q: Wash your hands ___ you eat.
questions.explain: before 也是挂时间的词：吃饭「之前」洗手。

questions.q: First we did our homework, ___ we played chess.
questions.explain: 顺序词 then：先……然后……。写故事的骨架。

questions.q: If you practise every day, you ___ pass the exam.
questions.explain: if 句的主句用 will：就会通过。

questions.q: If it ___ sunny tomorrow, we will have a picnic.
questions.explain: if 半句不放 will → 用一般现在 is。

questions.q: I like winter ___ I can make snowmen.
questions.explain: 后面是原因 → because。

questions.q: Shall we go swimming ___ play football this afternoon?
questions.explain: 二选一 → or。

questions.q: The film was long, ___ it was very interesting.（但是）
questions.explain: 转折 → but。

questions.q: ___ I grow up, I want to be a music teacher.
questions.explain: 「长大的时候」→ When I grow up——KET 口语高频句。

questions.wrong: Because it was late, so we went home.
questions.answer: It was late, so we went home.
alt: Because it was late, we went home.
questions.explain: 双指挥：because 和 so 删一个，两种改法都对。

questions.wrong: I like my school. Because the teachers are kind.
questions.answer: I like my school because the teachers are kind.
questions.explain: because 半句不能被句号隔开单独站，连回主句。

questions.wrong: If it will snow tomorrow, we will make a snowman.
questions.answer: If it snows tomorrow, we will make a snowman.
questions.explain: if 半句里不放 will：If it snows…

questions.wrong: I was tired but I went to bed early.
questions.answer: I was tired, so I went to bed early.
questions.explain: 「累了→早睡」是因果不是转折：so。选连接词先想两句是什么关系。

questions.wrong: Hurry up, and you will miss the bus!
questions.answer: Hurry up, or you will miss the bus!
questions.explain: 「否则会误车」→ or。and 变成「快点就会误车」，意思反了。

questions.wrong: I like both singing and also dancing.
questions.explain: 中文「既……也……」直译堆词。and 一个就够。

questions.wrong: When I will finish my homework, I will call you.
questions.answer: When I finish my homework, I will call you.
questions.explain: 和 if 一样：when 挂的半句也用现在式，不放 will。

questions.wrong: She was ill, because she didn't come to school.
questions.answer: She was ill, so she didn't come to school.
questions.explain: 因果放反了：生病是原因，没来是结果 → so。（或改成 Because she was ill, she didn't come.）

questions.q: 辨析：两句关系是什么？I practised hard, ___ I still lost the game.
questions.explain: 努力了「却」输了——转折 → but。so 就变成「所以输了」，不合逻辑。

questions.q: 辨析：___ you are free this Sunday, come to my birthday party!
questions.explain: 「如果你有空」是条件 → If。邀请信常用。

questions.q: 哪句是错的？
options: I'll wait here until you come back.
If you will come tomorrow, we can play together.
She smiled when she saw the present.
We can walk or take the bus.
questions.explain: B 的 if 半句放了 will → If you come tomorrow…

questions.q: 哪句连接词用得最好？
options: I love the sea, so we often go to the beach in summer.
I love the sea, but we often go to the beach in summer.
I love the sea, or we often go to the beach in summer.
I love the sea because we often go to the beach in summer.
questions.explain: 爱大海（原因）→ 常去海边（结果）：so。D 把因果说反了。

questions.from: It was cold. I wore a coat.（用 so 连成一句）
questions.answer: It was cold, so I wore a coat.
questions.explain: 原因在前结果在后 → so。

questions.from: It was cold. I wore a coat.（用 because 连成一句）
questions.answer: I wore a coat because it was cold.
alt: Because it was cold, I wore a coat.
questions.explain: 同样两句换 because：原因挂在 because 后面。

questions.from: You press this button. The door opens.（用 if 连成一句）
questions.answer: If you press this button, the door opens.
alt: If you press this button, the door will open.
questions.explain: 条件挂 if；主句用现在或 will 都通。

questions.q: 综合：选出逻辑通顺的一句：
options: I didn't go out because I had a lot of homework.
I didn't go out so I had a lot of homework.
I didn't go out or I had a lot of homework.
I didn't go out and because I had a lot of homework.
questions.explain: 没出门的原因是作业多 → because。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：I want to learn the guitar, ___ I don't have time.
questions.explain: 想学「但」没时间 → but。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：You can come by bus ___ by bike.
questions.explain: 两种方式选一 → or。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：I love this song ___ the words are beautiful.
questions.explain: 后面是原因 → because。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：Bring an umbrella ___ it rains.
alt: in case
questions.explain: 「以防下雨/如果下雨」→ if。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：I was doing my homework ___ the phone rang.
questions.explain: 正做作业「这时」电话响了 → when。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：My sister likes dancing, ___ I like singing. We both love music!
alt: but
questions.explain: 并列陈述两人爱好 → and（转折 but 也讲得通，首选 and 因为下句说 both love music）。

questions.q: KET 写作（25词小作文）：哪句能同时拿 Organisation 分？
options: I like the park because I can play football there with my friends.
I like the park. I can play football. I have friends.
I like the park, football, friends.
Park is good. Football is good.
questions.explain: A 用 because 把三个信息连成一条线；B 是蹦豆子，C/D 连句子都不完整。

questions.q: KET 口语：Why do you like your best friend? 最好的回答：
options: Because she is funny and she always helps me.
questions.explain: Because + 两个原因用 and 连——口语高分模板。D 答非所问。

questions.q: 看图写故事：想说「他跑得很快，但还是没赶上公交」：
options: He ran fast, but he missed the bus.
He ran fast, so he missed the bus.
He ran fast, and he missed the bus.
He ran fast because he missed the bus.
questions.explain: 快跑「却」没赶上 → but。这一句是 Part 7 三图故事的经典中间句。

questions.q: 故事结尾：___ they got home, Mum made them hot tea.
questions.explain: 到家「的时候」→ When。故事里 when 挂过去的时间点。

questions.wrong: 写作自查：I like summer holidays. Because I can visit my grandparents. And swim every day.
questions.answer: I like summer holidays because I can visit my grandparents and swim every day.
questions.explain: 三个碎片连成一句：because 挂原因，and 连两个活动。25 词作文最需要这种整合。

questions.wrong: 写作自查：If you will come to my party, we will have a great time.
questions.answer: If you come to my party, we will have a great time.
questions.explain: 邀请信高频句：if 半句去掉 will。

questions.from: I stayed at home. It was raining.（用 because 连成一句）
questions.answer: I stayed at home because it was raining.
alt: Because it was raining, I stayed at home.
questions.explain: 原因挂在 because 后。

questions.from: Finish your homework. Then you can watch TV.（用 if 连成一句）
questions.answer: If you finish your homework, you can watch TV.
questions.explain: 条件句改写：先做完作业（条件）→ 才能看电视（结果）。

questions.q: 综合：给故事选最佳骨架词：___, we packed our bags. ___, we took a taxi to the station. ___, the train left at nine.
questions.explain: First… Then… Finally… 是叙事顺序骨架，Organisation 稳拿。

questions.q: 综合：We can't play outside now ___ it's too dark.
alt: as
since
questions.explain: 原因 → because（as/since 也通，KET 会 because 就够）。

specialWords.groupName: 并列三兄弟：and / but / or
specialWords.rule: 把两段「旋律」连成一句的连奏线。and 顺着接，but 拐个弯，or 给选择。KET 考纲连接词一共就 7 个，这是前 3 个。

words.ex: I like cats and dogs. 我喜欢猫和狗。
It's small but clean. 它小但是干净。
Tea or juice? 茶还是果汁？

specialWords.groupName: 从句四姐妹：when / where / because / if
specialWords.rule: 这 4 个把一个「小句子」挂到主句上：when 挂时间，where 挂地点，because 挂原因，if 挂条件。剩下的 4 个考纲连接词都在这。

words.ex: Call me when you arrive. 你到了就给我打电话。
This is the park where we play. 这是我们玩的公园。
I'm happy because it's Friday. 我开心因为今天是周五。
If it rains, we'll stay home. 如果下雨我们就待在家。

lessons.title: 量词 + 比较级：中文认为万物不可数
lessons.hiddenLineNote: good→better→best、bad→worse→worst——最常用的形容词，比较级最不规则。第三次遇见同一条规律：越常用的词，越不规则。现在你可以确认：这不是巧合，是英语的秩序。

sections.h: 中文 vs 英文的数数观
sections.text: 中文认为万物不可数，所以全要量词：一「本」书、一「条」鱼、一「杯」水。英文只认一半：书鱼苹果自己能数（two books），水面包米不能数，要借杯子袋子（a glass of water, a piece of bread）。
能数的用 many（many books），不能数的用 much（much water），a lot of 两边通吃——不确定就用它。
短词加 -er（taller, faster）；长词前面放 more（more beautiful）。为什么？你念念 beautifuler——念不出来吧？语言是懒的，怎么顺口怎么来。
A 比 B → A is taller than B。最高级前面要 the：the tallest in our class。

examples.en: How many eggs do we need?
There isn't much milk in the fridge.
A violin is smaller than a cello.
This is the most interesting book in our library.
examples.zh: 这是我们图书馆最有趣的书。

lessons.accept: 验收：可数/不可数分类 10 词对 8 个；用比较级和最高级各口头造一句。
lessons.parentScript: 家长话术：超市里玩分类——「这个英语里能直接数吗？」苹果能、大米不能。判断错了不纠正，回家查了明天再问一次。

exercises.q: How ___ water do you drink every day?
exercises.explain: water 不可数 → much。

exercises.q: There are ___ birds in the park in spring.
exercises.explain: birds 可数复数，a lot of 通吃。

exercises.q: An elephant is ___ (big) than a horse.
exercises.explain: 短词 -er，注意双写 g。

exercises.q: This film is ___ (interesting) than that one. (用 more…)
exercises.explain: 长词前放 more——beautifuler 念不出来，语言是懒的。

exercises.q: Winter is the ___ (cold) season of the year.
exercises.explain: 最高级 the + -est。

exercises.q: 改错：I ate three bread this morning.
exercises.answer: I ate three pieces of bread this morning.
exercises.explain: bread 不可数，要借「片」：pieces of。

exercises.q: How ___ brothers do you have?
exercises.explain: brothers 可数 → many。

exercises.q: There isn't ___ juice left in the bottle.
exercises.explain: juice 不可数 → much。

exercises.q: Can I have a ___ of water?
exercises.explain: 水借杯子数 → a glass of water。

exercises.q: Today is ___ (hot) than yesterday.
exercises.explain: 短词 -er，双写 t。

exercises.q: This is the ___ (good) noodle shop in our town!
exercises.explain: 暗线第三站：good→better→best，最常用最不规则。

exercises.q: My bag is heavy, but yours is ___ (heavy).
exercises.explain: y 变 i 加 -er。

exercises.q: Maths is ___ than English for me.
exercises.explain: 长词前放 more——difficulter 念不出来。

exercises.q: 改错：I drank two milks this morning.
exercises.answer: I drank two glasses of milk this morning.
exercises.explain: 牛奶不可数，要借杯子。

exercises.q: 改错：She is taller then me.
exercises.explain: 比较用 than，不是 then（然后）——拼写陷阱。

exercises.q: 验收：用最高级说一句你们班/乐团里的事
exercises.answer: Lily is the youngest player in our orchestra.
exercises.explain: the + -est + in 范围。（意思对即可）

teaching.essence: 中文认为万物不可数（所以全要量词），英文只认一半：书和苹果自己能数，水和面包要借杯子袋子；比一比：短词加 -er，长词请 more，比较后面挂 than。
teaching.why: 中文说一「本」书、一「条」鱼、一「杯」水——所有名词都要量词，因为中文把万物都当「不可数的材料」。英文把名词分成两队：可数队自己带复数（two books），不可数队没有复数、不能加 a（water / bread / rice），要说数量就借容器（a glass of water）。比较级也讲道理：taller 顺口就加 -er，beautifuler 念不出来就请 more 帮忙——语言是懒的，怎么顺口怎么来。

rules.point: 可数 vs 不可数：先分队
rules.detail: 能一个一个数的 → 可数（book, egg, apple）；像材料一样一团的 → 不可数（water, milk, bread, rice, money, homework）。不可数没有复数、前面不能放 a。

examples.en: Two eggs and some milk, please.
examples.zh: 两个鸡蛋和一些牛奶。（egg 可数，milk 不可数）

examples.en: I have a lot of homework today.
examples.zh: 我今天作业很多。（homework 不可数，没有 s）

rules.point: 不可数的借容器
rules.detail: 要数不可数名词，借个容器或单位：a glass of water / a cup of tea / a piece of bread / a bowl of rice。数字变大变容器：two glasses of water。

examples.en: Would you like a cup of tea?
He ate three pieces of bread.
examples.zh: 他吃了三片面包。（pieces 变复数，bread 不变）

rules.point: many / much / a lot of / some
rules.detail: 可数用 many（how many books），不可数用 much（how much water）；a lot of 两边通吃——不确定就用它；some 也两边通吃（some apples / some milk）。

examples.en: How many eggs do we need?
There isn't much milk in the fridge.
She has a lot of friends.

rules.point: 比较级：短词 -er，长词 more
rules.detail: 短词加 -er（taller / faster / smaller）；长词前放 more（more beautiful / more interesting）。比较的对象用 than 挂上：A is taller than B。

examples.en: A violin is smaller than a cello.
This song is more beautiful than that one.

rules.point: 最高级：the + -est / most
rules.detail: 三个以上比出冠军 → 最高级，前面必须有 the：the tallest in our class / the most interesting book。常跟 in/of 短语画出比较范围。

examples.en: Lily is the tallest girl in our class.
examples.zh: 莉莉是我们班最高的女生。

examples.en: This is the most interesting book in the library.
examples.zh: 这是图书馆最有趣的书。

notes: 拼写小规则：big→bigger（双写 g）、happy→happier（y 变 i）、nice→nicer（只加 r）。
people / children 天生就是复数：many people（不是 many peoples）。
money 不可数（钱是材料，硬币纸币才可数）：How much money…？time 表「时间」不可数，表「次数」可数（three times）。
「比……多得多」加 much：much taller（这里 much 是「得多」，不是量词）。

commonErrors.wrong: I bought three book.
commonErrors.why: 中文数完就完（三本书），英文名词自己还要变复数。8 类错误 8 号（灰区）——几乎不挡意思，写作检查时顺手加 s。

commonErrors.wrong: How many money do you have?
commonErrors.right: How much money do you have?
commonErrors.why: 钱看着能数，其实 money 是「材料」不可数 → much。能数的是 coins（硬币）。

commonErrors.wrong: She is taller than I am tall.
commonErrors.why: 中文「她比我高」逐字翻会重复。than 后面挂个 me（或 I am）就结束。

commonErrors.wrong: This film is more better than that one.
commonErrors.right: This film is better than that one.
commonErrors.why: better 已经是比较级了，再加 more 就是双重比较。good→better 不规则，专门背。

commonErrors.wrong: Lily is tallest girl in our class.
commonErrors.right: Lily is the tallest girl in our class.
commonErrors.why: 最高级是「唯一的冠军」→ 必须戴 the。中文没有这顶帽子所以最容易漏。

teaching.parentTip: 超市里玩分类——「这个英语里能直接数吗？」苹果能、大米不能。判断错了不当场纠正，回家查了明天再问一次。
teaching.darkline: good→better→best、bad→worse→worst——最常用的形容词，比较级最不规则。第三次遇见同一条规律：越常用的词，越不规则。现在你可以确认：这不是巧合，是英语的秩序。

questions.q: book（书）能一本一本数吗？
questions.explain: 书能数 → two books。

questions.q: water（水）能一个一个数吗？
questions.explain: 水是材料，不可数，要借杯子：a glass of water。

questions.q: rice（米）是？
questions.explain: 米粒太多数不过来，英文当材料 → 不可数。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ I bought three books.
questions.explain: 对。三本 → books 加 s。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ I drank two waters.
questions.explain: 错。water 不可数不能加 s → two glasses of water。

questions.q: How ___ eggs do we need?
questions.explain: eggs 可数 → many。

questions.q: How ___ milk is there in the fridge?
questions.explain: milk 不可数 → much。

questions.q: 一杯茶：a ___ of tea
questions.explain: 茶借杯子 → a cup of tea。

questions.q: 一片面包：a ___ of bread
questions.explain: 面包切片 → a piece of bread。

questions.q: tall 的比较级是？
questions.explain: 短词加 -er → taller。

questions.q: beautiful 的比较级是？
questions.explain: 长词念不动 -er → 请 more 帮忙。

questions.q: My brother is taller ___ me.
questions.explain: 比较对象用 than 挂上。

questions.q: good 的比较级是？
questions.explain: 不规则：good→better→best。最常用所以最不规则（暗线第三次出现！）。

questions.q: Lily is ___ tallest girl in our class.
questions.explain: 最高级冠军戴 the：the tallest。

questions.q: big 的比较级是 ___。
questions.hint: 提示：双写最后一个字母
questions.explain: 短元音+单辅音 → 双写 g：bigger。

questions.q: 这句话对吗？→ She has a lot of friends.
questions.explain: 对。a lot of 两边通吃，可数不可数都能用。

questions.q: There are ___ apples in the basket.
questions.explain: apples 复数 → some（some 两边通吃）。

questions.q: I don't have ___ time today.
questions.explain: time（时间）不可数 → much。

questions.q: How ___ people are there in your family?
questions.explain: people 天生复数、可数 → many people。

questions.q: Would you like ___ bread?
questions.explain: bread 不可数 → some bread，不能 a bread。

questions.q: He drank three ___ of orange juice.
questions.explain: 数字变大变容器：three glasses of juice。

questions.q: My homework is ___ than yours.（作业更多用 more）
questions.explain: more = much/many 的比较级：作业比你的多。

questions.q: An elephant is ___ than a horse.
questions.explain: heavy → y 变 i 加 er：heavier。

questions.q: This maths problem is ___ than that one.
questions.explain: difficult 长词 → more difficult；比较两个用比较级不用最高级。

questions.q: Summer is ___ season of the year in our city.
questions.explain: 一年四季比出冠军 → the hottest（双写 t）。

questions.q: My violin is old, but hers is ___.
questions.explain: 两把琴比 → 比较级 older。

questions.q: Today is ___ than yesterday. Let's go out!
questions.explain: 今天和昨天比 → warmer。

questions.q: Who is ___ student in your class?
questions.explain: 全班比冠军 → the best（good 的最高级）。

questions.q: There isn't ___ juice left. Shall I buy some?（much/many）
questions.explain: juice 不可数 → much。

questions.q: A cello is ___ (big) than a violin.
questions.explain: 双写 g：bigger than。

questions.q: This is ___ (interesting) film of the year.（最高级）
questions.explain: 长词最高级 → the most interesting。

questions.q: I'm ___ (happy) today than yesterday.
questions.explain: y 变 i：happier。

questions.wrong: I bought three book yesterday.
questions.explain: 8 号中式错误（灰区）：数字后名词也要变复数 → books。

questions.wrong: How many money do you have?
questions.answer: How much money do you have?
questions.explain: money 是「材料」不可数 → much。

questions.wrong: She drank a water and ate two breads.
questions.answer: She drank a glass of water and ate two pieces of bread.
questions.explain: 不可数借容器：a glass of water / two pieces of bread。

questions.wrong: This film is more better than that one.
questions.answer: This film is better than that one.
questions.explain: better 已是比较级，more 多余——双重比较。

questions.wrong: Lily is tallest girl in our class.
questions.answer: Lily is the tallest girl in our class.
questions.explain: 最高级冠军必须戴 the。

questions.wrong: My bag is heavier than you.
questions.answer: My bag is heavier than yours.
questions.explain: 包和「你的包」比，不是和「你」比 → than yours。中文省略害的。

questions.wrong: There are many peoples in the park.
questions.answer: There are many people in the park.
questions.explain: people 天生复数，不加 s。

questions.wrong: Maths is difficulter than English for me.
questions.answer: Maths is more difficult than English for me.
questions.explain: difficult 长词，念不动 -er → more difficult。

questions.q: 辨析：much 的两副面孔：She is ___ taller than her sister.
questions.explain: 这里 much = 「高得多」，加强比较级。very 不能配比较级（very taller 错）。

questions.q: 辨析：homework 怎么数？
options: I have a lot of homework.
questions.explain: homework 不可数：没有复数、不能加 a → a lot of homework。

questions.q: 哪句是错的？
options: He is the fastest runner in our school.
I have less homework than you.
She is more taller than me.
questions.explain: D 双重比较：taller 前不能再加 more。

questions.q: 两个人比还是三个人比？Tom is ___ of the two boys.
questions.explain: 两个人比用比较级，锁定其中一个加 the：the taller of the two。（KET 读懂即可）

questions.from: My room is small. Her room is smaller.（用 than 连成一句）
questions.answer: Her room is smaller than mine.
alt: My room is bigger than hers.
questions.explain: 她的房间更小 → Her room is smaller than mine.（或反过来：My room is bigger than hers.）注意比较方向别写反。

questions.from: bad 的比较级和最高级？（用空格隔开写两个词）
alt: worse, worst
questions.explain: bad→worse→worst，和 good→better→best 一样不规则——越常用越不规则。

questions.q: 综合：___ students in our class like music, but not ___ of them play an instrument.
questions.explain: students 可数 → 两处都用 many。

questions.q: 综合：选出全对的一句：
options: Can I have two cups of tea and some biscuits?
Can I have two cup of teas and some biscuit?
Can I have two cups of teas and many biscuit?
Can I have two tea and biscuits some?
questions.explain: 数字变容器（cups），tea 不变，biscuits 可数加 s。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：How ___ does this T-shirt cost?
questions.explain: 问价钱固定用 How much。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：There were ___ of people at the concert.（很多）
alt: a lot
questions.explain: lots of / a lot of people。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：Can I have a ___ of water, please?
alt: cup
bottle
questions.explain: 水借容器：a glass/bottle of water。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：My new school is much ___ (big) than my old one.
questions.explain: much + 比较级：bigger（双写 g）。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：I think English is ___ (easy) than maths.
questions.explain: y 变 i：easier than。

questions.q: KET Part 5 式填空：Yesterday was ___ (hot) day of the summer.
questions.explain: 整个夏天比冠军 → the hottest（双写 t）。

questions.q: KET 写作：想写「我的新学校比旧学校大，老师也更友好」：
options: My new school is bigger than my old one, and the teachers are friendlier.
My new school is more big than my old one, and the teachers are more friendly.
My new school is bigger than my old one, and the teachers are friendlier than.
My new school is biggest, and teachers friendliest.
questions.explain: bigger + friendlier（y 变 i）。C 的 than 后面空着不行，要么删 than 要么补对象。

questions.q: KET 口语：Which do you like better, summer or winter? 高分回答：
options: I like summer better because the days are longer and I can swim.
questions.explain: better + because + 比较级 longer——把 L7 和 L8 连起来用就是高分。

questions.q: 购物场景（KET 听力常考）：How much are the apples? 正确的回答：
questions.explain: How much 问价钱 → 回答价格。别听成 how many（问几个）。

questions.q: 菜单点餐：想要「一碗米饭和一些鸡肉」：
options: A bowl of rice and some chicken, please.
A rice and some chickens, please.
One rice and many chicken, please.
Bowl rice and chicken some, please.
questions.explain: rice 借碗（a bowl of），chicken 当肉讲不可数 → some chicken。

questions.wrong: 写作自查：I have much friends at my new school.
questions.answer: I have many friends at my new school.
alt: I have a lot of friends at my new school.
questions.explain: friends 可数 → many（或 a lot of）。much 只配不可数。

questions.wrong: 写作自查：Beijing is one of the bigger city in China.
questions.answer: Beijing is one of the biggest cities in China.
questions.explain: 「最大的城市之一」→ one of the + 最高级 + 复数：the biggest cities。

questions.from: The red bag costs 50 yuan. The blue bag costs 30 yuan.（用 expensive 的比较级说红包更贵）
questions.answer: The red bag is more expensive than the blue one.
alt: The red bag is more expensive than the blue bag.
questions.explain: expensive 长词 → more expensive than。

questions.from: No student in our class is taller than Ben.（用最高级改写）
questions.answer: Ben is the tallest student in our class.
alt: Ben is the tallest in our class.
questions.explain: 没有人比 Ben 高 = Ben 是最高的 → the tallest。

questions.q: 综合：读天气预报比较：Today is 28°C, yesterday was 31°C. 哪句对？
options: Today is the coolest than yesterday.
Today is more cool than yesterday.
questions.explain: 28 比 31 低 → cooler。C 最高级不配 than，D 短词不用 more。

questions.q: 综合：Of all the instruments, I think the violin has ___ (beautiful) sound.
questions.explain: 所有乐器里比冠军 → the most beautiful。

specialWords.groupName: 直接 + er / est：短词标配
specialWords.rule: 比较级 = 尾巴挂 er（更…），最高级 = 挂 est + 前面加 the（最…）。大多数短词直接挂。

specialWords.groupName: 哑巴 e 结尾：只加 r / st
specialWords.rule: 已经有个 e 在门口了，就别再排队——直接 +r / +st。

specialWords.groupName: 辅音 + y → ier / iest
specialWords.rule: 和三单变 ies 一个脾气：y 变 i 再加 er / est。

specialWords.groupName: 短元音护体：双写辅音 + er / est
specialWords.rule: 和 -ing 双写一个道理：短元音 + 单辅音的短词，先双写末尾辅音护住读音。

specialWords.groupName: 不规则变化：乐队的老炮儿
specialWords.rule: 越常用的词越不规则（暗线第三次出现！）——这几个必须整组背下来，KET 年年考。

specialWords.groupName: 常见不可数名词：不能加 a，也没有复数
specialWords.rule: 中文觉得万物可数，英文里这些偏偏不可数——前面不能加 a/an，尾巴不能加 s，「多少」用 much / some / a lot of。

words.zh: 新闻 ★长得像复数其实不可数

specialWords.groupName: 量词搭配：给不可数名词发「碗」
specialWords.rule: 不可数名词要论「份」，就借一个容器/单位：a ___ of + 名词。想说复数就变容器：two cups of tea。

specialWords.groupName: 名词复数不规则：不走 -s 的老户口
specialWords.rule: 这些老词的复数是「换脸」不是「加 s」——woman → women 连读音都大变（/ˈwɪmɪn/）。sheep 和 fish 更懒，单复数同形。
